items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: And after about three or four months, I joined Celestan's band. And I remained with them for about eight or nine years.

ctx.x: There were big lawn parties out there too, I guess.

There were big lawns on both sides. Yeah, right. It was a contest every Tuesday night between different groups. And I played with Sidney Desvins band first. And after about three or four months, I joined Celestan's band. And I remained with them for about eight or nine years. And then...
Who else was in Celestan's band at that time? At that time?
